======== 1. make -n build-freebsd（必須含 GOOS=freebsd、-trimpath、-ldflags -s -w）========
CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=freebsd GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=755d07c -X main.buildTime=2026-08-25T12:18:46Z -X main.commit=755d07c" -tags "with_quic with_utls with_wireguard with_acme with_clash_api" -o gboard-node-freebsd-amd64 ./cmd/gboard-node

======== 5. mocked install（uname=FreeBSD → freebsd 成品＋rc.d，不寫 systemd）========
# bash tests/install/freebsd_build_test.sh happy
kind=freebsd service=rcd rc=0
urls=https://github.com/jasonsamtago/Gboard-Node/releases/download/dev/gboard-node-freebsd-amd64
RESOLVE_DOWNLOAD_URL=https://github.com/jasonsamtago/Gboard-Node/releases/download/dev/gboard-node-freebsd-amd64
RESOLVE_OS=freebsd
RESOLVE_SERVICE_PATH=/usr/local/etc/rc.d/gboard-node
RESOLVE_FILE=gboard-node.rcd
RESOLVE_FILEBODY # PROVIDE: gboard_node
RESOLVE_FILEBODY . /etc/rc.subr
RESOLVE_FILEBODY rcvar="gboard_node_enable"
RESOLVE_FILEBODY run_rc_command "$1"
# 無 [Unit]、無 systemd unit。PASS=4 FAIL=0

======== 6. mocked install（未知 OS／缺成品明示失敗，不准當 linux）========
# unknown：
unknown kind=explicit rc=1 urls=
unknown out=[ERROR] Unsupported OS: UnknownOS (will not treat as linux)
# missing freebsd artifact：
missing kind=explicit rc=1
urls=https://github.com/jasonsamtago/Gboard-Node/releases/download/dev/gboard-node-freebsd-amd64
# 兩者都沒有改拿 gboard-node-linux-*。PASS

======== 7. Linux 邊界（路徑不動）========
linux kind=linux service=systemd rc=0
linux urls=https://github.com/jasonsamtago/Gboard-Node/releases/download/dev/gboard-node-linux-amd64
# 仍 systemd＋*-linux-*。PASS
